sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 - vals.ai
sources.snippet: We evaluated DeepSeek's DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 across our benchmark suite. It ranks #18 on the Vals Index (52.37%), up 9.48 points from DeepSeek V4 (42.89%). Its standout result is SWE-bench Verified, where it places #2 of 82 models (96.40%) and is the highest-scoring open-weight model on the board, ahead of Kimi K3 (93.40%).

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 · Models
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is the official release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, superseding the preview version, with greatly enhanced agentic capabilities and performance improvements that are especially pronounced in production environments. It is built on the DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) model structure, with a DSpark speculative decoding module attached.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813: Specs, Pricing, API and Benchmark Boundaries ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek's current deepseek-v4-pro API version is DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813, with the calling name unchanged. It is a text-only 1.6T-total/49B-active MoE model with a 1M-token context window and 384K maximum output, offering non-thinking, Think High, and Think Max modes plus the Responses API, Anthropic-compatible access, JSON output, and tool calls.
